extracted.intended_audience: general readers, fans, and researchers interested in Tig Notaro and stand-up comedy
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedia-style biographical profile summarizing Tig Notaro's life, career, comedic style, personal history (including cancer), and film/TV/audio credits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comedic style — deadpan / observational / personal
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes Notaro as known for her deadpan comedy; historically observational but after her cancer diagnosis shifted toward personal comedy, reflecting on her childhood and life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original phrasing: 'She is known for her deadpan comedy.' 'Previously she was more distant and observational, but now she reflects on her childhood and her life.' Use of personal material (post-cancer) is emphasized as part of her current style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approach to material — do whatever is funniest / no preconceived identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Notaro's stated approach: prioritize what is funniest regardless of form or tone; she will perform dark bits, use props like a sock puppet or a stool, and does not limit herself to a single persona.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original quote: 'I'm always going to do whatever I think is funniest. If something's dark, I'll do it. If it's a sock puppet, if it's a stool, I'll do it. There's no preconceived idea of who I think I might be now.' Implication for producing comedy: be versatile and follow the material rather than a fixed identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of vulnerability / authenticity as performance device
rubrics_metrics.description: Notaro has used frank personal disclosure (including showing surgical scars onstage) to create powerful, memorable moments that blend survival, recovery, and comedic showmanship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from the page: her 2012 Largo set addressing cancer became 'instantly legendary'; a 2014 Town Hall set where she performed part of the set topless, 'showed the audience her scars' and made a 'powerful, even inspiring, statement about survival and recovery.' Guidance: vulnerability can be an effective tool to connect and create impact when handled with showmanship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career versatility — multi‑format work (stand-up, writing, acting, podcasts, TV/film)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notaro's career spans stand-up specials, albums, podcasts, TV writing/acting, films, Kickstarter series, and a memoir; collaboration and multimedia output are central to her profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists examples: Comedy Central Presents, This American Life monologue, podcasts (Professor Blastoff), Kickstarter series (Clown Service), albums (Good One, Live), TV shows (One Mississippi, Inside Amy Schumer), documentaries (Knock Knock, It's Tig Notaro). Implication: a successful contemporary comedy career often combines live performance with recorded/audio work, writing, and screen projects.
